---

Sign in with your OVO Energy Australia account to track energy usage, costs, solar generation, and connected vehicles.

Your energy plan and rates are automatically detected from OVO's API. No manual plan selection or rate entry required.

**Privacy & Security:**
• Credentials are stored in Home Assistant's configuration storage
• They are used only to access your data through OVO's services
• Short-lived access tokens are refreshed first
• Your password is used again only if OVO rejects the refresh token
• Credentials are never shared with third parties or external services
